description: Org-change and seller email templates of the synthetic layer v1 (spec sections b, c). Same register and length as the CRMArena-Pro emails. Plain business language only: no rule, feature or outcome wording (the leakage test scans this file).

champion_leaves.subject: Personal update
bodies:
Hi {seller_first},

I wanted to let you know personally that I will be leaving {company} at the end of this month to take on a new role elsewhere. It has been a pleasure working with you on {product}, and I appreciate the time you have invested in understanding our needs.

I am making sure the notes from our conversations are passed on so nothing is lost in the handover. Someone from the team will be in touch once responsibilities are confirmed.

Thank you again for everything.

Best regards,

{buyer_full}
{company}

seller_note.subject: {product}: a quick introduction
bodies:
Hi {buyer_first},

I am working with your colleagues at {company} on {product} and wanted to reach out to you directly, as your perspective on how the work runs day to day would be valuable. If it is useful, I would be happy to walk you through how other teams have set things up and hear what matters most on your side.

Would a short conversation in the next couple of weeks suit you?

Best regards,

{seller_full}

seller_value.subject: Re: pricing for {product}
bodies:
Hi {buyer_first},

Thank you for being open about the budget. I would like to keep the proposal as it stands and instead show you where the return comes from: the time your team saves each week, the reduced effort on routine reviews, and the support that is included from day one.

I have put together a short summary of those numbers for {company}. Could we go through it together this week?

Best regards,

{seller_full}

seller_technical.subject: Re: your questions on {product}
bodies:
Hi {buyer_first},

Thank you for the detailed questions. Short answers are below, and I am happy to go deeper on any of them. In brief, {product} works alongside the tools you already use, setup typically takes a few weeks, and access controls can be configured to match your current policies.

If it helps, we can set up a working session to go through the specifics with your team.

Best regards,

{seller_full}

seller_outreach.subject: {product} at {company}
bodies:
Hi {buyer_first},

I understand you have recently become involved in the discussions about {product} at {company}. Welcome, and thank you for taking the time. I would be glad to bring you up to speed on where things stand and answer any questions you have.

Would a short call next week work for you?

Best regards,

{seller_full}
